sources.title: OpenAI: GPT-6.1 Sol (Sep 29)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: OpenAI launched GPT-6.1 Sol on Sep 29, 2026 (day-only) as upgrade to GPT-6 Sol: near-Astra intelligence at one-fifth Astra standard prices.
claims.context: OpenAI announcement page Sep 29 + API changelog Sep 29 entries, full bodies read.

claims.text: Standard $2 input / $10 output / $0.10 cached input per 1M (cached 95% below standard, 50% below GPT-6 Sol cached); Astra $10/$50/$1.00; Luna $0.10/$0.50/$0.01.
claims.context: Vendor price card (announcement + changelog converge: $2/$10/$0.10 cached; changelog adds $2.50 cache-write, 272K threshold).

claims.text: DeepSWE v1.1 matches Astra at ~1/5 cost (+6.4pp over GPT-6 Sol); GDP.pdf above Opus 5.5 with fallbacks at <1/2 cost; AutomationBench +2.2pp over Opus 5.5; OSWorld 2.0 offline +7pp over Sol; Terminal-Bench Science >2x Sol at <1/2 cost; factuality error 11.4%->7.7% low effort.
claims.context: Vendor-run evals in research/API environment; competitor scores from public reports.

claims.text: ChatGPT Work + Codex for Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise/Edu from Sep 29; NOT in Chat; API gpt-6.1-sol; multi-agent beta.
claims.context: Vendor availability statement; Ultrafast for 6.1 Sol coming soon (Oct 8 post-window, not W40).

limitations.text: All benchmark deltas vendor-run; independent reproduction pending.
